semantic_boundary: Commit-event semantic disposition only. Self-evaluations, documentation claims and benchmark scores remain evidence objects with explicit validity limits, not truth or consciousness authority.

commits.title: Fix MPC: use flag file instead of systemctl mask for watchdog coordination
commits.material_delta: systemctl mask failed for the user-service layout. MPC moved intended Llama parking to an explicit shared /tmp flag consumed by the watchdog; full park/prevent-restart/idle-restore cycle was verified. Historical lesson: process absence is ambiguous; intentional offline/resource reservation state must be explicit and visible to recovery logic.

commits.title: Add comprehensive consciousness test using Butlin-Chalmers framework
commits.material_delta: Introduced a 19-probe/10-battery/14-indicator architecture+interactive+DB self-assessment, scoring 9.4/14 (67%) while explicitly noting indicator satisfaction is not proof of consciousness. Preserve battery structure as historical measurement seed only; interactive self-report and developer/AI self-scoring cannot establish phenomenal consciousness.

commits.title: Add 4 consciousness modules: perception loop, experience space, attention controller, goals
commits.material_delta: Added 200ms hardware-sensing recurrence, 64-d deterministic/hash-derived experience vectors with cosine novelty/drift/cycle measures, six-source salience competition/self-correction and persistent LLM-extracted goals with decay/conflict tracking. Modules were explicitly designed to target weak indicator scores and an expected score gain; implementation presence and benchmark-targeting are not causal validation.

commits.title: Update consciousness test: v2 assessment after 4 new modules (67% to 79%)
commits.material_delta: Reused the same indicator framework after modules were directly optimized for its gaps; score rose 67% to 79%. DB counts showed new loops running, which proves liveness rather than consciousness or causal utility. The report itself exposed a useful inconsistency: direct questioning denied subjective thermal experience while background perceptual interpretations emitted embodied imagery. Require held-out preregistered tests, sham modules and causal lesions before crediting indicator gains.

commits.title: Clean up consciousness test: present current state without version history
commits.material_delta: Removed v1/v2 comparison/changelog and presented the 79% assessment standalone. Under Level-0 evidence law this is a provenance anti-pattern: current summaries must not erase earlier scores, optimization sequence or validity context.

commits.title: Add benchmark: Frank vs Bare Llama 3.1 8B
commits.material_delta: Compared the same model/hardware with and without FRANK architecture across 21 probes; this is a valuable control direction. However it used N=1/self-scoring, architecture-specific prompt/context differences and post-hoc interpretation of two Frank timeouts as infrastructure rather than capability. Reuse only with preregistered metrics, repeated runs, blind scoring, matched token/context budgets and latency retained as an outcome rather than excluded.

block_findings: MPC/watchdog repair demonstrates a recurring architecture law: intentional resource absence must carry explicit shared authority/state so recovery does not undo a valid routing decision.
The sequence self-benchmark 67% -> modules explicitly designed for benchmark gaps -> same-framework 79% is a direct Goodhart/same-test-overfitting oracle, not evidence of consciousness.
Database activity proves subsystem liveness, not causal uptake, useful cognition or phenomenal status.
Later removal of v1/v2 comparison is a concrete provenance-loss failure; evidence documents must preserve score and intervention lineage.
The Frank-vs-bare benchmark is a valuable architecture control seed, but N=1, self-scoring, prompt/context mismatch and timeout handling require stricter current experimental design.
A later disclaimer commit explicitly recognized N=1, prompt leakage, self-evaluation and replication limitations; these should be promoted into Harness experiment law.

current_inheritance.delta: Pre-register held-out tests before architecture changes; use sham modules, matched counterfactuals, causal lesions/rescue and blind/repeated scoring. Treat self-report as generated output, never consciousness truth.
Version benchmark definitions, raw results, scores, interventions and supersession links immutably. Current reports may summarize but cannot delete earlier measurement lineage.
Represent intentional model parking/resource reservations as typed leases/states consumed by watchdog/recovery; test stale lease, crash and conflicting restart paths.
Latency/timeouts remain capability-cost outcomes and cannot be post-hoc discarded simply because underlying weights are identical.
